reviews.author: Mia Derstine
reviews.text: Traveling to Scotland, and there comes a time when the next meal MUST be Asian noodles or I’ll die. I’m fairly picky about ramen so it’s always a gamble, but this place was great. Got the chicken ramen with a very mildly spiced miso broth. Broth was tasty, but not too rich - I literally finished the entire bowl. Noodles were really interesting, in a good way. They weren’t a classic alkaline springy ramen, BUT they had a nice al dente texture that almost reminded me of soba. Nothing breaks ramen like a soggy sad noodle, and I’m happy to report these noodles passed the test! Service was fast and friendly. Apps were good. And reading everyone’s sticky notes and doodles on the walls was really cute. I’d definitely go back!

The restaurant had a casual and inviting atmosphere, making it easy to enjoy ramen. It's wonderful to find a bowl like this overseas. Thank you for the delicious meal. I then asked for a lychee juice (something I have everytime I visit your aberdeen store), server didn't know and would have to check. My sons ramen came and it was missing the pork and I never got a drink to have with my food, not by choice. When we asked for containers to take the food home they didn't bring enough and we had to ask for one more for my sons ramen. We didnt get a bag, we were not offered so as we were carrying out 4 containers of food someone not in uniform asked us if we would like a bag. If this had been my first experience in a maki and ramen I would not hurry back. But within the last 7 days I have been to your aberdeen store, here everything is exceptional especially the staff and service. I have also visited your Leith store, which was good. We were told the visit today was below par because the staff were new!

reviews.text: First visit. I ordered steak ramen the menu stated medium rare. It came very well done and broth was lukewarm. I sent it back. The waitress said the chef is preparing you a fresh one. It came back 2 minutes later steak was overdone and tough. It had obviously been nooked and reheated in a microwave. My daughter ordered the chicken Laksa and complained that the chicken was compressed sliced chicken not good for value for £18.50. We complained to the manager. She said she had no idea whether the chicken came in prepacked or ready cooked. She said we would not have to pay. We would have refused anyway as we had one mouthful each. The Manager offered us complimentary cocktails or desserts we refused and she gave us £40 vouchers which we still haven't used. Considering they are just up from Waggamommas they have strong competition and honestly not a patch on Waggas they really need to to their game.

reviews.author: manesh Patel
reviews.text: Went there nearly 2 weeks ago for a birthday. Used their 50% off food discount. Atmosphere was pretty good and so was the food. Service however was astonishingly poor on the day. Apparently some staff didn't turn up and even though the place wasn't busy, it was one staff member for the entire resturant. This meant food and service was significantly delayed and some luke warm food served. This isn't the fault of the staff memeber. However we also realised after paying and leaving the venue that the discount applied was incorrect and i have been over charged. Tried emailing and calling to get this resolved with proof of reciept. No answer. Please get in touch with me to resolve! Been nearly 2 weeks now and still unresolved.

reviews.author: Jasmine Patel
reviews.text: My partner and I were really excited to try this new ramen spot out, however we were disappointed with our experience. When ordering drinks, we were told they hadn't got any coke in stock and it just got worse from there really.. the ramen lacked flavour, the broth tasted powdery, the boiled egg was stone cold and the noodles were stiff. The whole dish tasted cheap - nothing authentic about it and nothing compared to the real thing in Japan. Sorry, I would not recommend this place!

reviews.author: RACE MAK
reviews.text: Really enjoyed my meal at Maki Nori in Soho. The handrolls were freshly made and the A5 Wagyu and Duck Foie Gras ones were definitely my favourites. The sashimi was fresh too, and I really liked the presentation of the sushi boat with dry ice. We also had the Hokkaido Cheese Tart for dessert, which was a nice way to finish the meal. Overall, a lovely place for a date night or special occasion. Would definitely come back!

reviews.text: The food is incredible, without a doubt. I wish I could rate higher than 5 for the service alone. Navin is an asset to the business offering excellence and charm to the experience. I don’t wanna sound like an AI plug so def will b recommending to my friends and colleagues!

reviews.author: Nick S
reviews.text: We had an incredible time at Maki Nori Food was spectacular! All the seafood was super fresh and flavourful, make sure you try the handrolls & crudo! Navin went above and beyond ensuring we had an amazing night. He made sure we're were comfortable and gave us the best service we've had in London so far. The entire team were incredible and the vibes immaculate. Would absolutely recommend ❤️

reviews.author: Asad-ali Rehemtulla
reviews.text: Kaitlin and Navin made every effort to make us feel comfortable and laid out the menu and special Chef's items for us. Most of the menu is Halal friendly with no alcohol in the sushi rice and all the sauces which is rare for a Japanese in central. The food was fantastic Amazing Nagiri and Sashimi. The Chef's Ceviche and the Miso Aubergine hand roll were outstanding. Definitely coming back
